name: Original issue dates for Texas HVAC (TDLR) and plumbing (TSBPE) licenses
reason: TDLR 'All Licenses' (7358-krk7) publishes license number, holder and expiration date only; no original issue date. TSBPE publishes no bulk open dataset with original license dates. Trade-license dates are therefore never used; SOS charter/COA dates are the only record dates.

name: Texas SOS filing history (SOSDirect)
reason: Paid, login-only per-entity search; no bulk open access. Conversion/merger history that can reset a charter date is not checked.

name: Per-loan web page on data.sba.gov
reason: SBA publishes only bulk CSVs; loan evidence links point to the CSV plus the LoanNumber.
